items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: And Bonnie Bigard and myself. They had rumors that we were the best sax section in New York at that time.

ctx.x: Oh well, something else. As I say, I know almost nothing about him. Some people told me that it might have been his father or his uncle they were talking about, the old Lorenzo or Papa, that they talked a little bit with an accent, a French accent. Did young Lorenzo still have a French accent? He did. He did too.
At that time, he the young fella, he did have a French accent. But he taught me and Bonnie Bigard taking lessons from the Teos also, but from the daddy, I think.
